body.title: Add ArtifactStore.update and childrenOfStrict
body.summary: Add update(id, by, mutate, options) whose mutate may be async and which holds the per-artifact queue across the read, the mutate and the write, recovering any pending journal operation under the queue before it reads the head or the history; add childrenOfStrict returning the readable children and the unreadable heads. Binding requirements 2 and 6.
acceptanceChecks: two competing lifecycle-only operations through update both land in order and neither is lost, an async mutate is awaited under the queue, and a mutate that throws writes nothing
a head replace that fails after the log append is finished by the next update before it reads, and the retry is logged once
childrenOfStrict returns an unreadable child that childrenOf skips

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-update.test.ts: update runs read, mutate and write inside the queue, awaits an async mutate, keeps two competing operations in order and writes nothing when mutate throws
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-update.test.ts: a head replace that failed after the log append is finished before update reads, and the retry is logged once
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-children-strict.test.ts: childrenOfStrict returns an unreadable child that childrenOf skips
